messages:
Sam: Quick q for folks heading to NeoAI Thurs — anyone got a travel power strip or EU adapter I can borrow? My room only has one outlet and no USB-C :(. Also debating an eSIM for the 5 days — any carrier recs? I can share neck pillow if anyone needs.
Maria: I have a small 3-outlet power strip (US->EU) I can bring. Happy to split shipping if you want it permanently. I use Airalo for short trips — super easy and cheap. DM me.
Jonah: Airalo worked fine for me in BCN last month. Pro tip: buy the eSIM before you land so data kicks in instantly. Also turn off background app refresh to save the plan. :+1:
Emily: FYI the conference sometimes hands out a limited number of local SIM vouchers at the registration desk — snag one early.
Tess: I'm landing 12:30 and taking a taxi into the city. I can squeeze one more person in if anyone needs a ride. DM ETA.
Alex: Hotel concierge usually keeps a couple of surge protectors behind the desk — worth asking. I’ll also bring a USB-C PD power brick and a short USB-C cable if anyone forgets theirs.
trip-bot: Reminder: ride-share spreadsheet updated -> https://redwood.co/offsites/neoai-ride-share (please add flight # and arrival time).
Maria: Quick question — do we need printed badges or is mobile QR fine? Last conf I had a scanner fail and paper saved me.
Emily: Mobile QR worked for me at NeoAI 2024 but carry a screenshot or PDF just in case the app is flaky.
Sam: Awesome, thanks everyone. Maria, can I borrow your strip? Tess I’ll take that taxi if still available. I'll DM details.
Jonah: If anyone wants a spare charging cable I’ll have an extra USB-C->C. Also bringing some earplugs and a sleep mask if anyone forgot theirs.
Sam: Crowd-sourced survival kit coming together. See y'all there :party_parrot:
notes: This thread is travel banter: gear trade, eSIM tips, ride-share and badge backup advice. Short, informal replies and a bot reminder.
